test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 09
subject: general
question: The Lokpal of India observed its foundation day on 16 January 2026. Which of the following statements regarding the Lokpal of India is ***incorrect***?

options.text: Lokpal was established after the coming into force of the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013, on 16 January 2014.
Lokpal consists of a Chairperson and eight members, including four Judicial and four Non-Judicial members.
Lokpal has the mandate to inquire into corruption allegations against the Prime Minister, Union Ministers and Members of Parliament.
Lokpal directly conducts suo-moto criminal trials and awards punishments in corruption cases.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Lokpal directly conducts criminal trials and awards punishments in corruption cases.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Lokpal of India observed its Foundation Day on 16 January, marking its establishment under the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Lokpal was established on 16 January 2014 after Section 3 of the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 came into force.**
 
• It consists of a Chairperson and eight Members, including four Judicial and four Non-Judicial members.
 
• Its jurisdiction covers corruption complaints against the Prime Minister, Union Ministers, Members of Parliament and central government officials.
 
• Lokpal does not conduct criminal trials or award punishments; it inquires into complaints and can direct investigative agencies such as the CBI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Lokpal of India__

 __
 
• A statutory anti-corruption body at the Union level.
 
• Functions as an independent ombudsman to ensure accountability in public life.
 
 
 
• Appointment Process__
 __
 
• Members are appointed by the President of India.
 
• Appointments are based on recommendations of a Selection Committee under Section 4 of the Act.
 
 
 
• Powers of Lokpal__
 __
 
• Can order preliminary inquiries and investigations.
 
• May refer cases to agencies like the CBI but does not act as a trial court.
 
 
 
• Objective__
 
 
• To promote integrity, transparency and accountability in governance.
 
• To strengthen public trust in democratic institutions.
